samples.title: Phân loại rác
samples.prompt: In situations related to sorting household waste, residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable. What are the causes of this problem, and what could be done to address it?
requirementsVi: Giải thích nguyên nhân.

samples.summaryVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that neighbourhoods should make household waste sorting easier, a practical difficulty is that residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

the proposal that

parts.text: neighbourhoods should make household waste sorting easier, a practical difficulty is that residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that the instructions and collection system may not match. This can help explain why residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable. Consider the following situation: a careful resident may see all bins emptied into one truck and decide not to separate waste again. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
